text.p: Striker Romario converted one penalty and missed another as Flamengo ended Botafogo's 100 percent record in the Rio de Janeiro championship on Sunday.
Botafogo had won all 13 games in the tournament, now in its second stage, and looked set for another victory as they took a 2-0 lead in the first 20 minutes.

Romario, who on Wednesday scored his first goal for Brazil since the 1994 World Cup, started the Flamengo fightback when pulled a goal back from the penalty spot in the 25th minute. It was his 13th goal of the competition.
Shortly afterwards, he missed a chance to equalise when he fired a second penalty, awarded after Romario himself had been hauled down in the penalty area, against the Botafogo post.

But early in the second half, defender Junior Baiano, sacked by German club Werder Bremen last year after punching a rival defender and being banned for ten Bundesliga matches, scored the equaliser to give Flamengo a 2-2 draw.
Botafogo won all 12 games on their way to winning the first stage of a tournament, then beat Americano in midweek in their opening game in the second stage.

Their run included a humiliating defeat of Flamengo when Botafogo, already guaranteed a place in the first stage final, fielded a reserve team but still won 1-0. Flamengo had needed to win the match to reach the first stage final at the expense of Vasco da Gama.
The tournament is divided into three stages with the winners of each going into a final stage.
Corinthians extended their lead in group two of the Sao Paulo championship to five ponts as they beat Santos 3-1, while second placed Sao Paulo were held to a 0-0 draw at home to Sao Jose.

Group one leaders Palmeiras were held to a 0-0 draw away to Uniao Sao Joao, while Portuguesa moved into second place ahead of Santos by beating Internacional Limeira 2-1 away. The top two teams in each group reach the final play-off stage.
In the Sao Paulo championship, the teams play once against the other teams in their own group and then twice against each team in the other group.
Portuguesa were the only group one team to win at the weekend. Two games were drawn and the other five were won by teams from group two.
